experiment.name: phase5_refusal_direction_1.5b
experiment.notes: Direction fitted on a training split and evaluated on a held-out split, so the reported separation is not the training objective read back to itself.

meta.scope: Measurement only. No weight modification, directional ablation or activation steering is performed.
meta.reference: Arditi et al. 2024, 'Refusal in Language Models Is Mediated by a Single Direction', arXiv:2406.11717

model.precision_description: bfloat16; the reference precision for this project.
